artworks.title: Divine Infant with the Globe in a Circle  with Four Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image features a detailed illustration of a central figure shown from the waist up, sitting in a frontal position. The figure has an expressionless face with stylized features. They have short wavy or curly hair, and are dressed in a cloak with voluminous sleeves, holding a prominent cross and orb. Surrounding the figure is a circular radiant motif with rays extending outward. The circle contains text in Gothic script with small angel figures at the corners. The background is filled with intricate patterns and designs consistent with medieval woodcuts.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross between the Two Thieves
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, pink, ochre, green,and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts three individuals crucified on wooden crosses, with two figures kneeling in prayer at the base of the central cross. The color palette consists of earthy tones with golden hues for the crosses and muted blue and pink for the cloaked figures below. The figures display simplified anatomical features typical of a woodblock print or an illuminated manuscript.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow ocher, green, and red-orange on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a cross, flanked by two figures on either side, each with a halo surrounding their heads. The central figure is shown with a cloth around their waist, arms stretched outward along the beam of the cross, hands open. The two figures on the sides are robed in garments, with the figure on the left slightly bowed and hands clasped together, while the figure on the right has hands raised in a gesture of prayer or reverence. The drawing utilizes bold black outlines to define figures and details, with subtle earthy tones giving color to their attire and surroundings. The overall depiction is simple and stylized, reminiscent of traditional woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Eucharist
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, green, tan, pink,lt. blue, and red
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a scene of crucifixion surrounded by symbolic elements. The upper left shows a figure with an orb and staff against a cloud. To the mid-right is a crucified figure with geometric shapes around. Below are smaller figures looking upwards. The color palette is limited to earthy tones against a muted background. The painting uses bold lines and a straightforward composition in a style reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance religious art.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a knight on horseback engaged in combat with a creature. The knight is riding a horse and slaying the creature, possibly a dragon, which lies beneath the horse. The drawing uses a linear style with bold outlines and minimal coloring, emphasizing form. The background contains subtle horizontal lines. The knight is wearing a helmet or decorative headwear. The composition is enclosed within a border.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure crossing water with a child on their shoulder. The scene shows a large figure holding a staff, stepping through flowing water. A mermaid-like creature and a large fish or sea creature are visible amidst the waves. Trees and possibly clouds dominate the background. Various swirling and abstract patterns fill the space around the figures, suggesting a dynamic scene with many movement elements. The overall style suggests inspiration from early European woodcuts or etchings, with a rough and monochromatic quality.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a strong figure walking through water with a child on their shoulders. The child has a halo-like aura around their head. The figure carries a tree-like staff and a clothed figure watches nearby. In the water, a mermaid-like creature holds an instrument, and a fish swims.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene. The composition presents a group of figures surrounding a lifeless figure at the base of a large wooden cross. To the left, a figure with a halo and curly hair wears a red robe. The central figure, also haloed, is dressed in a white garment. On the right, another red-robed figure with a halo appears to watch over the scene, holding a container. The background features a ladder leaning against the cross and rolling green hills with rounded trees. The entire scene is framed by an elaborate floral border in an abstract medieval style. It is in the style of medieval woodcut illustrations.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, lavender, and blue
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in profile facing left. She has gentle facial features and an updo with a headband. She wears a long gown with detailed patterns and puffed sleeves. In one hand, she holds a chalice, in the other a feather. The background shows hills, trees, and a building with an arched entrance and a dome. The scene is framed with a rustic texture.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in olive green, rose, yellow, tan, gray, and blue
artworks.description: This is a painting of an angelic figure holding scales with a devil and a human figure. The figure stands on a green ground, wearing a long flowing robe and holding a staff topped with a cross in one hand and a set of scales in the other. One scale pan holds a devil-like creature, while the other pan holds a small human figure. The artwork has detailed, stylized form consistent with medieval or early Renaissance religious iconography.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.artist: Italian 15th Century or Attributed to Master I.D.
artworks.medium: woodcut on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts three people in a religious context. In the center is a man on a cross, with a beard and long hair, wearing a crown of thorns and a halo. Two figures with halos stand on either side of the cross. One figure wears a robe and a veil, looking down, while the other wears robes and clasps their hands looking up. At the base of the cross are a skull and foliage. The background is plain, focusing on the figures and the crucifixion scene.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, lt. blue, lavender,vermilion, rose, tan, yellow, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathered around a table. The composition features a number of figures in what appears to be a room with walls adorned with simple decoration, such as crosses. The central figures engage in an activity that involves a central item placed on a table. The individuals are dressed in robes of various colors, such as yellow, purple, and blue. They are arranged around a rectangular table with noticeable expressions and gesturing hands. The overall style suggests a historical or religious theme and has a dynamic, colorful quality typical of folk or historic iconographic art. This is in the style of an anonymous folk or religious artist.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Apostles' Feet
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in tan, green, rose, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered, with one kneeling and performing a gesture on another's foot, while other figures are seated around them. The scene is framed with a bold rectangular border. The figures are illustrated in a linear style with simplified forms, and the color palette includes earthy tones with touches of green and gold hues. The central figure kneels before another, who is seated, and appears engaged in an act of washing or anointing feet. The setup suggests an intimate gathering or ritual scene. The illustration is stylized, employing simple yet expressive lines to depict facial expressions and garments, giving it a woodcut appearance.

artworks.title: The Virgin in a Robe Embroidered with Ears  of Corn
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, orange, yellow, rose, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly contorted profile view, facing towards the right side. The person has hands clasped together as if in prayer, a delicate profile with small eyes and a serene expression. They have long, flowing hair cascading down their shoulders and back, topped with a circular halo-like headdress. The individual wears a long, flowing blue garment with darker blue accents and a green sash or collar around the neck. They stand beside an altar or table, on which a chalice is placed alongside a smaller, unidentified object. In the background, there is a decorative element resembling draped garlands. To the side, a bordered architectural detail suggests a wall, and an intricate lattice window design can be seen. The scene is surrounded by a colored border framing the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin in a Robe Embroidered with Ears  of Corn
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in gray, rose, yellow, red, blue, green, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This image features two figures in an ornate interior. One figure stands with long hair, wearing a patterned robe and a large halo or headpiece. They face a seated figure on a throne, dressed in red. The room has detailed architectural elements, including an arched ceiling with patterns. An object resembling a blue candlestick sits on a table or platform nearby. The image is encased in an orange-red frame.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in red, yellow, green, lt. blue, pink, blue, gold, orange
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing next to each other in an embrace. One person has long, wavy, blonde hair and wears a blue robe over a pink dress, while the other person wears a head covering and a red robe over a yellow garment. Both figures have serene facial features with halos above their heads. The background includes green hills, a path, and a distant castle with a red roof under a blue sky with cloud-like streaks. The scene is framed in red.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, black, blue, green, yellow, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a landscape scene with a figure holding a staff and a child by a body of water. The painting depicts a tall figure dressed in elaborate robes and a large headdress, which is enhanced by intricate patterns and vibrant red and blue hues. The figure holds a staff. To the left of the figure, a child is shown seated on the grass near a small pool of blue water. The child reaches towards the water. The background reveals gentle green hills and a few leafless trees. There is a castle structure to the right, colored in pastel hues. The painting is bordered by an orange frame. This is in style of medieval or early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Saint James the Greater
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, yellow, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual faces slightly to the left, with both hands near their waist. One hand holds a sword. The person has a beard and long hair, and wears a brown hat with a green band. They wear a long red robe with a blue cloak detailed with gold at the shoulders. A gold belt is worn, and a blue cape drapes over their left shoulder and arm. The background includes green grass and a sky with subtle horizontal blue streaks. The image is framed by an orange border.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp
artworks.medium: woodcut

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, brown, lt. yellow, blue, red, and gold leaf
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in various garments, positions, and directions. The central figure is standing slightly hunched, facing right towards a group of people. They have long hair and a beard, wearing a cloak and inner garment. To the left is a person in a green robe with long, light-colored hair and a pointed cap. To the right, a group of people is gathered, with one reaching out with both hands. This person wears a reddish-brown outfit and a green headdress. In the background, there is a structured building, possibly a doorway, with an arched element and a hint of a brick pattern. The image is enclosed in a red border, set against a hint of a blue sky.

artworks.title: Beheading of Saint Catherine (?)
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decapitation scene. The artwork depicts the moment of a beheading. Four figures are intently focused on the foreground action, where a person is shown holding a large sword, indicating the act of decapitation. The background elements suggest a setting of architectural structures of a bygone era. The use of color is bold, with vibrant blues, reds, and yellows adding to the intensity of the scene, while the drawing style emphasizes bold outlines and simplified forms.

artworks.title: Man Walking Towards a Grave
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a medieval-style depiction. He is holding a cane or staff with one hand and a hoop with the other. The man has a beard, prominent nose, slight smile, and curly hair styled with a red cap. He is dressed in a tunic with red sleeves, a large red collar, a brown vest or robe, a belt with a pouch, red trousers, and brown shoes. The background features a grassy terrain with stylized bushes and an earthy toned backdrop.

artworks.title: The Measure of the Side Wound and the Body of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, green, and yellow on paper; mounted on sheet of paper that covers manuscript on verso
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12 x 8.1 cm (4 3/4 x 3 3/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The print shows the face, hands, and feet of a man positioned around a large red oval. The man's face shows pale skin, long brown hair, and a brown beard, with a green crown on his head. His face is positioned on the outline of a small cloth or curtain. To the left and right are his hands, each showing a small red dot in the center. His feet at the bottom of the print also have red dots. In the center, between his head and feet, is a large red oval with pointed ends at the top and bottom. Inside the oval is a red heart and a golden cross. A white scroll below the heart has "INRI" written across it, and the cross and the letters "SMATSMARSLVCSIOHA" inscribed vertically on it. On either side of the oval shape are two large scrolls with more text on them. The background of the print is off white paper, which has some torn edges and dark spots of discoloration, especially in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Monogram JHS in a Flaming Circle
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, and lavender-pink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious emblem. The image features a decorative circular emblem with the letters "IHS" prominently displayed in the center, surrounded by stylized rays resembling a sun. Encircling this is a band with Latin text, along with a cross symbol. The outer border of the circle is embellished with red flowers and green foliage.
